notes.subject: ciira cia maũndũ-marũ
notes.rationale: תוֹכַחַת חַיִּים: 'reproof of life' (construct, KJV/ASV) vs 'life-giving reproof' (BSB reads it adjectivally)

notes.subject: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת
notes.rationale: personified ear — the ear itself 'hears and lodges'; Hebrew makes the body-part the subject, flattened in Gĩkũyũ to a conditional sense

notes.subject: mũthomi
notes.rationale: proverb summons the reader to be the listening ear that dwells among the wise

translation: Gũthũri kũigua ciira cia maũndũ-marũ nĩgũikara gatagatĩ ka arĩa mari na ũgo.
